name: amalgame
description: Syntax highlighting + LSP client + DAP debugger for the Amalgame programming language (.am files).

amalgame.serverPath.description: Path to the amc binary used as the LSP server. Defaults to `amc` (must be on PATH). Set this to an absolute path or to ${workspaceFolder}/amc to point at a local build.

amalgame.enableLsp.description: Enable the LSP client. Disable to fall back to syntax-only highlighting.

amalgame.dapServerPath.description: Path to the amc binary used as the DAP server (`amc dap`). Empty string falls back to `amalgame.serverPath`. Set this if your debug builds need a different amc than your LSP.

amalgame.dapBridge.description: Run `amc dap` in bridge mode (`--bridge`). The bridge translates DAP↔gdb-MI in-process so List/Map/Set/Closure variables pretty-print with summaries + drill-down, and runtime helper frames (Amalgame_*, _runtime_*, GC_*) are hidden from the call stack. Disable to fall back to the v0.8.0 `execvp` proxy (lldb-dap on macOS, gdb --dap on Linux gdb ≥ 14).

amalgame.dapShowRuntime.description: When bridge mode is on, include `Amalgame_*` / `_runtime_*` / `GC_*` frames in the call stack instead of filtering them out. Useful for runtime-level debugging.

program.description: Absolute path to the compiled binary. Build first with `amc build -g <entry.am>`.

args.description: Arguments passed to the debugged program.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the program's first statement.
